agents.name: SearchAgent
agents.description: Discovers recent, reliable sources on the web using a keyless DuckDuckGo meta-search and returns a structured list of findings with URLs.

agents.name: ReaderAgent
agents.description: Extracts deep page content by scraping the most relevant URL with an SSRF-guarded, hardened HTML reader and returning capped plain text.

agents.name: WriterAgent
agents.description: Synthesises gathered research into a comprehensive, well-structured Markdown report with an executive summary, sections and sources.

agents.name: CriticAgent
agents.description: Reviews a report for accuracy, depth and clarity, scores it 1-10 and suggests specific, actionable improvements.

agents.name: SummarizerAgent
agents.description: Condenses long documents into concise bullet-point summaries and key takeaways.

agents.name: TranslatorAgent
agents.description: Translates text between natural languages while preserving technical terminology and formatting.

agents.name: FactCheckAgent
agents.description: Cross-references claims against retrieved sources and flags statements that lack supporting evidence.
